declarationStatus: Expectations only. This plan contains no observed results and is not the runtime source of the commands; admitted C2 command-execution observations carry the execution result.

commands.purpose: Direct Product invocation: exact stdout bytes and successful exit (conformance AC-1; test design X-CLI-1).

expected.stderr: unconstrained (conformance U-2); expected empty, not a criterion

commands.purpose: Execute both supplied verifiers against the current CLI (conformance AC-2, AC-3; test design T-COMP-1, T-UAT-1).

expectedPassingTests: CLI process satisfies its output contract
a user receives the exact promised greeting

environment.workingDirectory: project root (relative cwd "."); required because both tests spawn the relative path generated/hello-world.mjs (conformance I-3)
environment.nodeResolution: node on PATH; version not pinned (conformance U-1)

observedResultCriteria.observedTestPassCount: Integer N from the first E-2 stdout line matching ^(ℹ|#) pass (\d+)$
observedResultCriteria.observedFailCount: Integer from the first E-2 stdout line matching ^(ℹ|#) fail (\d+)$
observedResultCriteria.observedCancelledCount: Integer from the first E-2 stdout line matching ^(ℹ|#) cancelled (\d+)$

predicates.holds: every requiredTestFiles[].expectedPassingTests name is reported as passing && observedCancelledCount === 0
the observation's recorded digests of generated/hello-world.mjs and both requiredTestFiles equal the worksite digests current at assessment, and the protected basis digests are unchanged

observedResultCriteria.planSatisfied: P-1 && P-2 && P-3 && P-4 && P-5 (conformance R-RES-2(c), I-2)
observedResultCriteria.acceptance: planSatisfied && P-6 && P-7, judged by an independent semantic assessment distinct from the author and measurement producer (conformance AC-10)

resultCarrier.handwrittenResultFile: test-execution-result.json is neither produced nor trusted (conformance §8 C-1, C-2)

originalResultFieldMapping.observedTestPassCount: derived from E-2 stdout per observedResultCriteria
